rounds.name: English Channel / Strait of Dover
rounds.fact: The Strait of Dover is the narrowest part of the English Channel, marking the boundary between the Channel and the North Sea.

rounds.name: Reykjanes Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Reykjanes peninsula in southwestern Iceland is characterized by active volcanism and extensive post-glacial lava fields.

rounds.name: Andaman and Nicobar Islands
rounds.fact: The Andaman Islands form an archipelago in the northeastern Indian Ocean separating the Bay of Bengal from the Andaman Sea.

rounds.name: Puget Sound
rounds.fact: Puget Sound is a complex estuarine inlet along the northwestern coast of the U.S. state of Washington.

rounds.name: Stewart Island
rounds.fact: Stewart Island is the third-largest island of New Zealand, located south of the South Island across Foveaux Strait.
